title: Juicy Purple-Sprouting Vietnamese Broccoli Banh Xeo
description: A light and refreshing Vietnamese crepe filled with purple-sprouting broccoli, perfect for a weeknight dinner or lunch.
instructions: Mix together coconut milk, salt, sugar, and vegetable oil in a large bowl.
In a separate bowl, whisk together rice flour and water until smooth.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Heat a mini cast-iron skillet or individual cocotte over medium heat.
Pour 2 tbsp of the batter into the skillet and tilt to evenly coat the bottom.
Place a few pieces of purple-sprouting broccoli and chopped cilantro on one half of the crepe.
Add 1-2 pieces of tofu on top of the broccoli.
Fold the crepe in half to enclose the filling.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the bottom is golden brown.
Loosen with a spatula and flip the crepe.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes or until the other side is also golden brown.
Repeat with the remaining batter and filling ingredients.
Serve hot with a squeeze of lime juice.
